description: Redesign the Alerting pages (Thresholds, Channels, Connectors, Routes, Delivery Logs, Dead Letters, Member Preferences) and Team pages (Members) with modern UI/UX. Improve card-based layouts, table density, and form experiences. Also redesign the Usage page and Activity page for consistency.
steps: Redesign src/pages/workspaces/ProjectThresholdsPage.tsx: (a) Add visual threshold cards in addition to the table view showing the metric being monitored with a gauge-like visual. (b) Improve the threshold form with better preset selection (visual cards with icons). (c) Add a 'status at a glance' panel showing currently firing vs healthy thresholds. (d) Better severity color coding with stronger visual indicators.

Redesign src/pages/workspaces/ProjectAlertChannelsPage.tsx: (a) Improve channel cards with channel-type specific icons and better visual organization. (b) Add delivery success rate indicator per channel. (c) Improve the preferences section with a matrix-style editor. (d) Better toggle interaction with animated state transitions.

Redesign src/pages/workspaces/ProjectConnectorsPage.tsx: (a) Improve subscription cards with better visual density and connector status. (b) Add a visual flow showing the alert routing path. (c) Better category selection with pill-style multi-select.
Redesign src/pages/workspaces/ProjectAlertRoutesPage.tsx: (a) Improve route visualization with a more visual representation of source to target. (b) Better route creation wizard.

Redesign src/pages/workspaces/ProjectMembersPage.tsx: (a) Improve the member table with avatar initials (monogram style per design system). (b) Add a role distribution mini-chart. (c) Better role selector with descriptions visible. (d) Improve the add member dialog with search-as-you-type.

Redesign src/pages/workspaces/ProjectUsagePage.tsx: (a) Improve the plan consumption meter with better visual styling and threshold markers. (b) Better counter table with inline sparklines. (c) Add a usage forecast indicator.

Redesign src/pages/workspaces/ProjectActivityPage.tsx: (a) Improve the activity timeline with better visual grouping by time periods. (b) Add activity type icons with semantic coloring. (c) Better JSON metadata viewer with syntax highlighting.

Redesign remaining pages (AlertDeliveryLogsPage.tsx, DeadLetterQueuePage.tsx, MemberAlertPreferencesPage.tsx, AlertRouteWizardPage.tsx) with consistent modern styling matching the other redesigned pages.
Follow all rules.md constraints and use existing shared primitives.
acceptance_criteria: All alerting pages have improved visual hierarchy and interactions
ProjectMembersPage has monogram avatars and better role management UX
ProjectUsagePage has improved meters and usage visualization
ProjectActivityPage has a better timeline with semantic coloring
All remaining project module pages are consistent with the redesign
All changes use theme tokens only - no hardcoded colors
npm run build completes without new TypeScript errors
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it passes without new errors
